exposed_AI_reference_use: Allowed only as explicitly exposure-qualified exploratory reference; not evidence of blinded strategy-independent assessment

reference_rule.scope: One shared F qrel mask per query, used unchanged for A/B/C/D
reference_rule.unknown_or_review_required: Exclude from the common judged projection, never grade zero

metrics.ties: Expected DCG over within-score ties; stable ID order is not preference
metrics.pairwise_agreement: Reference strict pairs only: correct=1, model tie=0.5, reversed=0; no strict reference pairs => null
metrics.kendall: Tau-b on fixed reference-known candidates; zero denominator => null; no p-values

semantic_review: Source-aware Codex model review sidecar referencing exact row hashes; never human Gold; negated caveats are not violations
sensitivity: Remove semantically disputed sufficiency rows from each shared F mask
Exclude every personal-evidence-based F row as a stronger conservative bound

cost_sensitivity.meaning: Predeclared dimensionless scenarios, not measured medical expenses; no tuning

aggregation.within_person: Mean across that person's evaluable fixed query contexts
aggregation.uncertainty: Participant distribution, min/max and leave-one-participant-out; no population significance claim

decision.READY_FOR_BASELINE_PILOT: Adequate source-audited shared F coverage, no unresolved provenance/isolation issue, evidence-dependent strict reference differences in at least two people, and positive C-minus-D utility in at least two people with direction robust to semantic sensitivity and not driven by one person
decision.REDESIGN_REQUIRED: Adequate exploratory F coverage but reference preferences are evidence-invariant, or personal/acquisition signal does not meet the above pilot criterion; no rejection of the research direction
decision.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Shared F labels or semantics do not meet the minimum reference coverage, so the ranking/acquisition question cannot be assessed
